    [global::SharpPack.Internal.Preserve]
    static void ISharpPackable<Node>.Serialize<TBufferWriter>(ref SharpPackWriter<TBufferWriter> writer, scoped ref Node? value) 
    {

        if (value == null)
        {
            writer.WriteNullObjectHeader();
            goto END;
        }
        var (existsReference, id) = writer.OptionalState.GetOrAddReference(value);
        if (existsReference)
        {
            writer.WriteObjectReferenceId(id);
            goto END;
        }
        var tempBuffer = global::SharpPack.Internal.ReusableLinkedArrayBufferWriterPool.Rent(
            out var tempBufferLeaseId);
        try
        {
            Span<int> offsets = stackalloc int[2];
            var tempWriter = new SharpPackWriter<global::SharpPack.Internal.ReusableLinkedArrayBufferWriter>(ref tempBuffer, writer.OptionalState);

            tempWriter.WriteUnmanaged(value.@Value); offsets[0] = tempWriter.WrittenCount;
            tempWriter.WritePackable(value.@Next); offsets[1] = tempWriter.WrittenCount;


            tempWriter.Flush();

            writer.WriteObjectHeader(2);
            for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
            {
                int delta;
                if (i == 0)
                {
                    delta = offsets[i];
                }
                else
                {
                    delta = offsets[i] - offsets[i - 1];
                }
                writer.WriteVarInt(delta);
            }
            writer.WriteVarInt(id);
            tempBuffer.WriteToAndReset(ref writer);
        }
        finally
        {
            global::SharpPack.Internal.ReusableLinkedArrayBufferWriterPool.Return(
                tempBuffer,
                tempBufferLeaseId);
        }
    END:

        return;
    }

/// <remarks>
/// SharpPack GenerateType: VersionTolerant<br/>
/// <code>
/// <b>int</b> Id<br/>
/// <b>string</b> Name<br/>
/// </code>
/// </remarks>
partial class Versioned : ISharpPackable<Versioned>, global::SharpPack.ISharpPackFormatterFactory<Versioned>, global::SharpPack.ISharpPackContextFormatterFactory<Versioned>
{

    static partial void StaticConstructor();

    static Versioned()
    {
        StaticConstructor();
    }



    [global::SharpPack.Internal.Preserve]
    static global::SharpPack.SharpPackFormatter<Versioned> global::SharpPack.ISharpPackFormatterFactory<Versioned>.CreateFormatter()
    {

        return new global::SharpPack.Formatters.SharpPackableFormatter<Versioned>();
    }

    [global::SharpPack.Internal.Preserve]
    static global::SharpPack.SharpPackFormatter<Versioned> global::SharpPack.ISharpPackContextFormatterFactory<Versioned>.CreateFormatter(
        global::SharpPack.SharpPackSerializerContext context)
    {

                if (context.HasFormatterOverrideDependency<int>() || context.HasFormatterOverrideDependency<string>())
        {
            return new __SharpPackContextFormatter();
        }
        return new global::SharpPack.Formatters.SharpPackableFormatter<Versioned>();
    }


    [global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.MethodImpl(
        global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
    static void __SharpPackSerializeWithFormatterOverrides<TBufferWriter>(
        ref global::SharpPack.SharpPackWriter<TBufferWriter> writer,
        scoped ref Versioned? value)
        where TBufferWriter : global::System.Buffers.IBufferWriter<byte>
    {

        if (value == null)
        {
            writer.WriteNullObjectHeader();
            goto END;
        }

        var tempBuffer = global::SharpPack.Internal.ReusableLinkedArrayBufferWriterPool.Rent(
            out var tempBufferLeaseId);
        try
        {
            Span<int> offsets = stackalloc int[2];
            var tempWriter = new SharpPackWriter<global::SharpPack.Internal.ReusableLinkedArrayBufferWriter>(ref tempBuffer, writer.OptionalState);

            tempWriter.WriteValue(value.@Id); offsets[0] = tempWriter.WrittenCount;
            tempWriter.WriteValue(value.@Name); offsets[1] = tempWriter.WrittenCount;


            tempWriter.Flush();

            writer.WriteObjectHeader(2);
            for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
            {
                int delta;
                if (i == 0)
                {
                    delta = offsets[i];
                }
                else
                {
                    delta = offsets[i] - offsets[i - 1];
                }
                writer.WriteVarInt(delta);
            }
            
            tempBuffer.WriteToAndReset(ref writer);
        }
        finally
        {
            global::SharpPack.Internal.ReusableLinkedArrayBufferWriterPool.Return(
                tempBuffer,
                tempBufferLeaseId);
        }
    END:

        return;
    }

    [global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.MethodImpl(
        global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
    static void __SharpPackDeserializeWithFormatterOverrides(
        ref global::SharpPack.SharpPackReader reader,
        scoped ref Versioned? value)
    {

        if (!reader.TryReadObjectHeader(out var count))
        {
            value = default!;
            goto END;
        }

        Span<int> deltas = stackalloc int[count];
        long totalDelta = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            deltas[i] = reader.ReadVarIntInt32();
            if (deltas[i] < 0)
            {
                SharpPackSerializationException.ThrowInvalidLength(deltas[i]);
            }
            totalDelta += deltas[i];
        }
        if (totalDelta > reader.Remaining)
        {
            SharpPackSerializationException.ThrowInvalidAdvance();
        }

        int __Id;
        string __Name;

        var readCount = 2;
        if (count == 2)
        {
            if (value == null)
            {
                if (deltas[0] == 0) { __Id = default; } else __Id = reader.ReadValue<int>();
                if (deltas[1] == 0) { __Name = default; } else __Name = reader.ReadValue<string>();


                goto NEW;
            }
            else
            {
                __Id = value.@Id;
                __Name = value.@Name;

                if (deltas[0] != 0) reader.ReadValue(ref __Id);
                if (deltas[1] != 0) reader.ReadValue(ref __Name);

                goto SET;
            }

        }
        // else if (count > 2)
        // {
            // SharpPackSerializationException.ThrowInvalidPropertyCount(typeof(Versioned), 2, count);
            // goto READ_END;
        // }
        else
        {
            if (value == null)
            {
               __Id = default!;
               __Name = default!;
            }
            else
            {
               __Id = value.@Id;
               __Name = value.@Name;
            }


            if (count == 0) goto SKIP_READ;
            if (deltas[0] != 0) reader.ReadValue(ref __Id); if (count == 1) goto SKIP_READ;
            if (deltas[1] != 0) reader.ReadValue(ref __Name); if (count == 2) goto SKIP_READ;

    SKIP_READ:
            if (value == null)
            {
                goto NEW;
            }
            else
            {
                goto SET;
            }

        }

    SET:
        
        value.@Id = __Id;
        value.@Name = __Name;
        goto READ_END;

    NEW:
        value = new Versioned()
        {
            @Id = __Id,
            @Name = __Name
        };

    READ_END:
        if (count == readCount) goto END;

        for (int i = readCount; i < count; i++)
        {
            reader.Advance(deltas[i]);
        }
    END:

        return;
    }

    [global::SharpPack.Internal.Preserve]
    sealed class __SharpPackContextFormatter
        : global::SharpPack.SharpPackFormatter<Versioned>,
          global::SharpPack.ISharpPackContextOverrideFormatter
    {
        public override void Serialize<TBufferWriter>(
            ref global::SharpPack.SharpPackWriter<TBufferWriter> writer,
            scoped ref Versioned? value)
            => __SharpPackSerializeWithFormatterOverrides(ref writer, ref value);

        public override void Deserialize(
            ref global::SharpPack.SharpPackReader reader,
            scoped ref Versioned? value)
            => __SharpPackDeserializeWithFormatterOverrides(ref reader, ref value);
    }

    [global::SharpPack.Internal.Preserve]
    static void ISharpPackable<Versioned>.Serialize<TBufferWriter>(ref SharpPackWriter<TBufferWriter> writer, scoped ref Versioned? value) 
    {

        if (value == null)
        {
            writer.WriteNullObjectHeader();
            goto END;
        }

        writer.WriteObjectHeader(2);
        writer.WriteVarInt(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.SizeOf<int>());
        writer.WriteVarInt(writer.GetStringWriteLength(value.@Name));

        
        writer.WriteUnmanaged(value.@Id);
        writer.WriteString(value.@Name);

    END:

        return;
    }

    [global::SharpPack.Internal.Preserve]
    static void ISharpPackable<Versioned>.Deserialize(ref SharpPackReader reader, scoped ref Versioned? value)
    {

        if (!reader.TryReadObjectHeader(out var count))
        {
            value = default!;
            goto END;
        }

        Span<int> deltas = stackalloc int[count];
        long totalDelta = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            deltas[i] = reader.ReadVarIntInt32();
            if (deltas[i] < 0)
            {
                SharpPackSerializationException.ThrowInvalidLength(deltas[i]);
            }
            totalDelta += deltas[i];
        }
        if (totalDelta > reader.Remaining)
        {
            SharpPackSerializationException.ThrowInvalidAdvance();
        }

        int __Id;
        string __Name;

        var readCount = 2;
        if (count == 2)
        {
            if (value == null)
            {
                if (deltas[0] == 0) { __Id = default; } else reader.ReadUnmanaged(out __Id);
                if (deltas[1] == 0) { __Name = default; } else __Name = reader.ReadString();


                goto NEW;
            }
            else
            {
                __Id = value.@Id;
                __Name = value.@Name;

                if (deltas[0] != 0) reader.ReadUnmanaged(out __Id);
                if (deltas[1] != 0) __Name = reader.ReadString();

                goto SET;
            }

        }
        // else if (count > 2)
        // {
            // SharpPackSerializationException.ThrowInvalidPropertyCount(typeof(Versioned), 2, count);
            // goto READ_END;
        // }
        else
        {
            if (value == null)
            {
               __Id = default!;
               __Name = default!;
            }
            else
            {
               __Id = value.@Id;
               __Name = value.@Name;
            }


            if (count == 0) goto SKIP_READ;
            if (deltas[0] != 0) reader.ReadUnmanaged(out __Id); if (count == 1) goto SKIP_READ;
            if (deltas[1] != 0) __Name = reader.ReadString(); if (count == 2) goto SKIP_READ;

    SKIP_READ:
            if (value == null)
            {
                goto NEW;
            }
            else
            {
                goto SET;
            }

        }

    SET:
        
        value.@Id = __Id;
        value.@Name = __Name;
        goto READ_END;

    NEW:
        value = new Versioned()
        {
            @Id = __Id,
            @Name = __Name
        };

    READ_END:
        if (count == readCount) goto END;

        for (int i = readCount; i < count; i++)
        {
            reader.Advance(deltas[i]);
        }
    END:

        return;
    }

}
